title: C2.7 R3 as a spec: boosted NLS soliton translates at v = 2Dk
description: Re-expression of jax_scout/phase_d_c2_7_rederivation.py R3 (boost n=1) as data. Same operator (_ops_flat: FEB with kinetic_mode=conservative, a_coupling=0, geom_off, D=1, a=0.8, s=-0.2, f=0), same Petviashvili soliton (A=1, sig=0.08, mu=0.2), same dt=2.5e-4 and T=3.

prediction.statement: A Galilean boost exp(ikx) of an exact NLS soliton translates it rigidly at v = 2Dk (Galilean invariance of the conservative branch with flat geometry). With D=1, k=2*pi/10: v = 1.25664. Mass is conserved by the unitary flow.
prediction.derivation: i psi_t = -D lap psi - g(|psi|^2) psi is Galilean invariant: psi(x - 2Dkt) exp(i(kx - Dk^2 t)) solves it if psi does.
